name: Elementals
notes: At creation select one elemental as the 0-16 Lineman. The other three are 0-2 Specials. Only the matching Incarnate Elemental can be hired.

name: Eonir
notes: Choose Forest Born or City Born when creating a team for Soul Weave; league commissioner rules determine the effect.

name: Numas
notes: A killed Human is resurrected as a standard Skeleton after the game, retaining SPP and learned skills in league play.

name: Tzeentch
notes: Before each game roll D6: 1-2 Troll, 3-4 Ogre, 5-6 Minotaur. The Changeling uses the selected Big Guy's stats and starting skills for that game.
